scale.label: 2.3 µm
scale.phenomenon: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength analogue: cortical activator-inhibitor wavelength

chronoseries_contrast.this_point: Holocene extant, 0 Ma, λ_c = 2.304 µm, five modes across an 11.52 µm vegetative cell
chronoseries_contrast.predecessor_regime: Molecular receptor-cluster length 0.20 µm admits N = 0 copies of λ_c, so the Turing band is closed
chronoseries_contrast.successor_regime: Extracellular cAMP aggregation waves are of order 1 mm (Höfer 1995; Sawai 2005). Same extant species, longer selected wavelength, not a later chronospecies
chronoseries_contrast.note: Chronoseries length is 1. There is no fossil predecessor species in this slot.

equations.kinetics: Schnakenberg 1979: f = a - u + u^2 v, g = b - u^2 v
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (Dv f_u + Du g_v) / (2 Du Dv)
equations.dispersion: sigma(k) = 0.5 * (tr(k) + sqrt(tr(k)^2 - 4 det(k))), using the discrete Laplacian eigenvalue

boundary_conditions.reason: A cortical patch of one vegetative cell with no-flux edges replaced by a periodic torus so integer modes 2π n / L are exact

empirical_claims.claim: A reaction-diffusion system can be stable without diffusion and unstable at a finite wavenumber when the inhibitor diffuses sufficiently faster than the activator.
The trimolecular mechanism a - u + u^2 v, b - u^2 v is a minimal chemical system used here as the kinetics that realize k_c.

In Dictyostelium discoideum, PIP3 and F-actin propagate as cortical waves and organize amoeboid shape through phase singularities. The waves are excitable and require F-actin feedback onto PI3-kinase.
Actin waves in Dictyostelium are a three-dimensional cytoskeletal self-organization pattern, i.e. a cortical spatial structure rather than a sorocarp-scale pigment stripe.
Coupling intracellular cAMP relay to chemotaxis turns a homogeneous cell layer into branching aggregation streams. That is the millimetre-scale successor regime of this slot.

transfer_boundary: The catalog wavelength 2.304 µm is the slot coordinate inside the cortical-wave band. No cited paper reports a measured Turing wavelength of exactly 2.304 µm.
Taniguchi 2013 is an excitable-wave phase analysis, not a Schnakenberg Turing integration. Schnakenberg kinetics are the reconstructed carrier of k_c.
The vendored photograph is a public-domain sorocarp (fruiting body), organism scale, not a 2.3 µm cortical micrograph.
